settings.reference: THE SAME KIND OF PLACE AS THE REFERENCE in each clip: look at the reference frame of that clip and recreate that location as a bright, clean American home or store (e.g. if the hook happens in a bathroom, the hook is in a bright modern American bathroom with white vanity and mirror, no toilet in frame; if the reference then moves to the kitchen, use the modern American kitchen from the avatar images). Describe the location fully in every frame prompt and keep small US flag details in the background

product.name: 200 Soluciones Naturales para Problemas Cotidianos
product.pitch: En mi libro tienes más de 200 recetas naturales como esta. Funciona como un botiquín natural para resolver problemas: en el índice tienes toda la información ordenada, solo identificas tu problema y eliges la solución que necesitas. Cada receta trae la lista de ingredientes con sus medidas exactas, instrucciones paso a paso, dosis recomendada y notas adicionales.

hookStyle: This is the HOOK of the video, so it must be very striking: exaggerate the gestures, the tone of voice and the facial expressions. The camera moves as if a person were filming her by hand, gently pushing in and pulling back.

models._nota: Modelo y esfuerzo de cada trabajador. Los que manejan Chrome usan uno más ligero para gastar menos límite.

amazonDisclosure: Como afiliada de Amazon, gano por las compras que cumplen los requisitos. #publicidad

results._nota: Analista de resultados: lee las visitas de tus reels. autoEveryHours 0 = solo a mano

edit._nota: Edición: acercamientos suaves de cámara (1-2 por video, como alguien grabando con el móvil). style "cuts" = cortes con zoom de golpe (lo de antes)

target: TARGET VIEWER: Spanish-speaking Hispanic WOMEN living in the UNITED STATES, mostly 60+ (also 45+ and 50+): moms and grandmothers from Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean and South America, family-oriented, practical, shop at Walmart/Target/Costco/Sam's, cook at home, trust grandma's remedies and want to save money. What they care about: joint and knee pain, energy and tiredness, sleep, digestion and bloating, belly fat after 50, blood sugar and blood pressure (only softened, never cure claims), menopause and hot flashes, strong bones, skin, hair and nails after 50, memory, swollen feet and legs, staying independent and healthy for the grandchildren. They do NOT care about gym, dating, babies, young-people trends or slang.

publish._nota: Reglas para cuando se suba a Instagram automáticamente
